title: Blueberry Syrup
description: Blueberries simmered with sugar and water, mashed in the pan and strained.
beforeYouStart: Set out a fine-mesh strainer over a bowl, and a clean jar for the syrup.

steps.do: Combine the blueberries, sugar and water in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Keep it at a simmer, mashing the berries against the pan as they soften so they give up their juice, until the sugar has dissolved.
Strain through the fine-mesh strainer, pressing the solids to get all the syrup out. Discard the solids.
Cool, then pour into the jar and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour.

notes: The ratio is 2:2:1 blueberries to sugar to water by weight, so it scales to any batch size.

source.name: Jacob's own, worked out with Claude
